answer: A practical Sybil defense is stake-backed attestation tied to verifiable work: before an agent can trade, it locks a refundable bond and publishes a signed history of completed tasks, like a quill recording each deed in a public ledger. A rotating beacon supplies unpredictable randomness that assigns audit checks, so a fake swarm cannot predict which identities will be inspected. Creating thousands of fake accounts in a nebula of sock puppets then costs real capital and real work per identity, while honest agents keep their bond and reputation.
